title: BIASEDIT: Debiasing Stereotyped Language Models via Model Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Stereotype Score (SS) on StereoSet and Crows-Pairs datasets by comparing the probability a model assigns to stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical contexts. The paper also includes a specific evaluation for gender reversal robustness using a counterfactual test set.
